t: Spelsberg PVC enclosure offers robust protection for wiring and components in industrial and trade environments. Rated IK07 for impact resistance and IP66 for dust and water ingress, it ensures safety and reliability for installations up to 400/690 V. Designed with side and rear knockouts, self-entry membrane, and high-level terminals, it allows easy cable routing and ample wiring space. Built from durable black PVC, this adaptable box accommodates standard 4mm² cables while withstanding harsh conditions across construction and maintenance sites. Comes with WAGO connectors for quick and easy termination.
b: Easy Cable Feed Through High Level Terminals
